title: Herbal facial steam blend
subtitle: A dried herb mix for a bowl facial steam
excerpt: Herbal facial steam blend is a dried herb mixture of chamomile, lavender, calendula, and peppermint, used by adding two tablespoons to a bowl of just-boiled water and leaning over it for five to ten minutes with a towel draped over the head. The steam softens the skin surface and makes pores easier to clean; the herbs make the steam smell pleasant. Makes 75 g, about five sessions.
sourceNotes: Herbal facial steam tradition: The Handmade Apothecary by Kim Walker and Vicky Chown (2017, Kyle Books). Chamomile and lavender as calming skin herbs documented in Galen's Bookshelf of Natural Beauty (historical compilation, 2019). Calendula as a skin-soothing herb: Mountain Rose Herbs botanical monographs (2022). Peppermint added for a cooling aromatic note. Steam session duration: 5 to 10 minutes maximum to avoid over-warming the face and triggering redness.

recipe.batchNotes: Scale up and store in a sealed jar. Two tablespoons per session.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Mix in advance and store in an airtight jar out of sunlight. The herbs retain their aromatic compounds best when sealed.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: One year in a sealed jar out of direct sunlight and heat. Dried herbs lose aromatic potency over time, replace when the blend smells flat rather than fragrant.

glossaryTerms.definition: The dried flower heads of Matricaria chamomilla or Chamaemelum nobile, used in teas, steams, and skin preparations. The mild scent and the naturally soothing character of the flower are both present in a facial steam.

content.text: Combine all dried herbs in a bowl and mix. Pour into a sealed jar. No processing is required, the blend is ready to use.

Cleanse the face first. Place two tablespoons of the blend in a large heatproof bowl. Pour over freshly boiled water and leave for one minute to let the water cool slightly. Lean over the bowl at a comfortable distance, not so close that the steam feels painful or very hot. Drape a towel over the head to trap the steam. Steam for five to ten minutes, taking breaks if the face feels too warm. Gently cleanse or apply a mask immediately after; rinse and moisturise.
One year in a sealed jar out of direct sunlight. Replace when the blend smells flat.
